async def act(page):
    # Click the target branch button 'primer/design' that is associated with the current target branch 'a11y/context-menu-accessibility-docs'
    target_branch_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="primer/design").filter(
        has=page.get_by_role("button", name="a11y/context-menu-accessibility-docs")

    await target_branch_button.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(1)  # Wait for dropdown to appear
    
    # Select 'dialog' from the dropdown options in the listbox
    dialog_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="dialog", exact=True)
    await dialog_option.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(1)  # Wait for selection to apply
    
    # Click 'Compare branches and continue' button to proceed to the next step
    compare_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Compare branches and continue")
    await compare_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait for page stability
